_doc: design-baseline adherence lint — the mechanical half of ADOPTION.md gate 2 (see docs/ADOPTION.md, docs/PLACEMENT.md). A consuming project wires a `lint:design` script pointing at this file and runs it in CI: warnings are allowed during rollout, and each rule is ratcheted to error as its violation class is cleaned. Only rules expressible as oxlint AST selectors live under `overrides`/`rules`; rules that need custom AST tooling (which oxlint cannot express natively as of this writing) are enumerated in `_candidate_rules_todo` below and grow into real checks as a plugin/codegen lands. The `overrides` glob targets the donor's own `src/**/*.tsx`; a consumer retargets it to its app-page directories (e.g. `src/app/(app)/**`), since these bans apply to page bodies, not marketing or auth chrome.

no-restricted-syntax.message: Page titles go through PageHeader — never a bare <h1> in a page body (PLACEMENT.md, Header slots).
Use the DS table primitives, not a raw <table> (ADOPTION.md gate 2).
Use the Button primitive, not a bare <button> (ADOPTION.md gate 2).

_candidate_rules_todo: exactly one primary action node per PageHeader — count primary-variant Buttons in a PageHeader subtree (custom AST rule)
RowActionsMenu is the only per-row overflow menu — ban a raw DropdownMenu inside list/grouped/board row render (custom AST rule)
no bg-red-50 / ad-hoc destructive color classes — scan className string literals; use the two canonical error treatments (Alert shell / tinted box), never a raw error color (custom className scan)
no local *-skeleton components — StateView owns the async planes; ban project-local skeleton/loading component definitions (custom identifier scan)
vendored-file @ds-version header stamp present — every vendored file carries a `/* design-baseline@<version> — vendored <date> */` header (custom top-of-file comment scan)
